vocabulary_note: SOURCE_SMARTART and PROCESS_DIAGRAM are in the allowed class list but are not used as a per-obligation proposal. They describe the EXISTING aggregate diagram T04-DGM-01, whose treatment is governed by D-05, not by any single step obligation. Bariah's BR-L1 asks for a visual per step, which is a different asset from the diagram that contains the steps.
process_nodes: Penyeliaan Alatan dan Mesin Penyelenggaraan Taman
Perancangan Sumber Manusia dan Kebajikan Pekerja

scope_asymmetry.observation: Under Landskap Lembut, Bariah wrote 'Their sub – perlu visual' (BR-L4). Under Landskap Kejur she named four groups and stopped (BR-L6); the eight source sub-items beneath those four groups are not covered by her ruling.
scope_asymmetry.handling: The inventory covers exactly what she named. No obligation was created for the eight Landskap Kejur sub-items. The asymmetry may be deliberate — the Kejur sub-items are one-line examples, whereas the Lembut sub-items are full management topics.
scope_asymmetry.reason: Part 9 restricts the follow-up to the six genuinely unresolved items, and asking Bariah to restate a ruling she gave clearly would be exactly the reconfirmation the brief prohibits.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: A supervisor briefing and demonstrating a maintenance task to a work crew on site
obligations.visual_purpose: Show that the first activity is instruction and demonstration, not the work itself.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: A supervisor observing and checking garden maintenance work in progress
obligations.visual_purpose: Distinguish supervision of maintenance from performing maintenance.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: Nursery operations — seedling beds, potting and plant holding areas under supervision
obligations.visual_purpose: Make the nursery visible as a distinct place of work, not an abstraction.

obligations.raw_source_heading: Penyeliaan Alatan dan Mesin Penyelenggaraan Taman
obligations.governed_display_heading: Penyeliaan Alatan dan Mesin Penyelenggaraan Taman
obligations.learner_facing_subject: Maintenance tools and machinery being checked and accounted for
obligations.visual_purpose: Anchor tool and machine supervision to physical objects the learner recognises.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: Garden inventory being recorded — stock, plants and materials counted against a list
obligations.visual_purpose: Show inventory supervision as a recording activity with an artefact.

obligations.raw_source_heading: Perancangan Sumber Manusia dan Kebajikan Pekerja
obligations.governed_display_heading: Perancangan Sumber Manusia dan Kebajikan Pekerja
obligations.learner_facing_subject: Workforce planning and worker welfare — shift or duty allocation and welfare provision
obligations.visual_purpose: Give the least concrete of the six steps something the learner can picture.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: The living elements the source names as soft landscape — trees, palms, shrubs and ground cover shown together as one category
obligations.visual_purpose: Establish the category before its three maintenance operations are taught.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: Watering in progress, supplying water to plants at the root zone
obligations.visual_purpose: Give the operation a concrete image before its methods are broken down.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: The two implementation routes the source names — manual watering beside automatic irrigation
obligations.visual_purpose: Frame the methods as a choice before either is described.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: A rubber hose with a spray nozzle in use
obligations.visual_purpose: Show the equipment the source names for manual watering.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: Sprinkler system beside drip irrigation — broad turf coverage against emitters at individual root zones
obligations.visual_purpose: Carry the distinction the source draws between the two automatic systems.
obligations.unresolved_issue: The two systems are LIST_ITEM rows (T04-ROW-012 and T04-ROW-014), not headings. They are bound to this obligation rather than given obligations of their own.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: PENDING — this heading groups four unrelated management topics and has no subject of its own in the source
obligations.visual_purpose: PENDING — whether a grouping heading earns its own visual is Bariah's call.
obligations.unresolved_issue: Grouping heading with no body text. A visual here would have to be invented.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: A watering schedule showing early-morning and late-afternoon slots, with midday excluded
obligations.visual_purpose: Make the timing rule the source gives readable at a glance.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: Water supply and pressure across a site — source, delivery and the pump and timer the contractor maintains
obligations.visual_purpose: Show that water management is a site-wide system, not a tap.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: The signs the source names — wilted dry leaves for under-watering against yellowed leaves and root rot for over-watering
obligations.visual_purpose: Both failure directions must be distinguishable, which is what the source teaches.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: Water cost against watering method on a large project
obligations.visual_purpose: Attach the cost point to something measurable.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: Fertiliser being applied to supply nutrients to plants
obligations.visual_purpose: Give the operation a concrete image before its methods are broken down.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: The three application methods the source names, side by side
obligations.visual_purpose: Frame the methods as a set before each is described.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: Granular fertiliser spread evenly around the root zone or across turf
obligations.visual_purpose: Show the spreading action that defines broadcasting.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: Small holes dug around a tree's root zone, fertiliser placed in and covered back
obligations.visual_purpose: Show the three-step action the source describes.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: Liquid fertiliser sprayed directly onto foliage
obligations.visual_purpose: Distinguish leaf application from soil application.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: PENDING — grouping heading with no subject of its own
obligations.visual_purpose: PENDING — Bariah's call.
obligations.unresolved_issue: Grouping heading with no body text.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: A fertilising programme sheet showing fertiliser type, NPK rate, quantity and schedule
obligations.visual_purpose: Show the programme as a document with named fields, as the source describes it.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: Fertiliser checked against the contract specification and the S.O.'s approval
obligations.visual_purpose: Make the approval step visible as a gate, not a formality.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: Fertiliser stored dry, secured and away from any water source
obligations.visual_purpose: The three storage conditions the source names must be readable in one image.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: A worker handling chemical fertiliser wearing gloves and a face mask
obligations.visual_purpose: Show the PPE the source names for this specific task.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: A fertilising record showing date, fertiliser type, quantity and area treated
obligations.visual_purpose: Show the record as evidence for a payment claim, which is the reason the source gives.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: The three threats the source names — insect pests, fungal disease and weeds
obligations.visual_purpose: Establish that pest control covers three different problems, not one.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: The IPM priority order — cultural, physical and biological control ahead of chemical
obligations.visual_purpose: The ORDER is the teaching point; a flat list would lose it.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: Good maintenance practice as prevention — correct watering and balanced fertilising
obligations.visual_purpose: Connect cultural control back to the two operations already taught.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: Diseased plant material removed by hand and weeds pulled out
obligations.visual_purpose: Show physical control as manual work.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: A pest's natural enemy used against it
obligations.visual_purpose: Biological control has no obvious image; a relationship diagram carries it.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: Controlled, targeted pesticide application rather than blanket spraying
obligations.visual_purpose: The words the source stresses are 'terkawal' and 'bersasar'.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: The three pesticide types the source names, side by side with their targets
obligations.visual_purpose: Type and target must be paired, which is exactly what the three rows state.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: Insecticide and the insect pests it controls
obligations.visual_purpose: Bind the type to its target.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: Fungicide and the fungal disease it controls
obligations.visual_purpose: Bind the type to its target.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: Herbicide and the weed growth it controls
obligations.visual_purpose: Bind the type to its target.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: PENDING — grouping heading with no subject of its own
obligations.visual_purpose: PENDING — Bariah's call.
obligations.unresolved_issue: Grouping heading with no body text.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: Pesticide use under statutory control, and a licensed operator's credential
obligations.visual_purpose: This is the unit's highest-consequence content and carries D-04.
obligations.unresolved_issue: D-04 — the base/reveal split for this row group is not confirmed.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: Full PPE for pesticide work — respirator, safety goggles, chemical gloves and protective suit; locked labelled ventilated store; Safety Data Sheet on file
obligations.visual_purpose: The three HSE obligations the source groups here must all be visible.
obligations.unresolved_issue: D-04 — the base/reveal split for this row group is not confirmed.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: Calm-weather spraying with no drift, warning signage posted, and a spray record
obligations.visual_purpose: Risk management is three separate obligations, not one.
obligations.unresolved_issue: D-04 — the base/reveal split for this row group is not confirmed.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: The permanent built elements the source names as hard landscape, shown as one category against the soft-landscape category
obligations.visual_purpose: Establish the second half of the unit and its contrast with the first.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: Walls, fences and level changes dividing outdoor space into distinct areas, with pathways, driveways and steps as movement routes
obligations.visual_purpose: Space-making and circulation are one function group in the source.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: A retaining wall holding a slope, with drains and graded surfaces carrying run-off
obligations.visual_purpose: Both engineering roles the source names belong in one image.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: Patios, decks and plazas in use, with gazebos, benches and landscape lighting
obligations.visual_purpose: Usability is shown by people using the space, which the source implies.

obligations.learner_facing_subject: Stone, timber and concrete adding texture, colour and pattern, and the contrast hard elements make against planting
obligations.visual_purpose: The source's own point is contrast, which needs two things in one frame.
